Remove **Show all dated notes** and return to explicit planner entries.

Cards require `planner_type: entry` and a valid date in the configured Date property. Thread notes use `planner_type: thread`. The common Planner folder, its optional entry/thread subfolders, property mapping and automatic settings saving remain unchanged.

**Updating from 0.3.0 or 0.3.1:** the removed setting is ignored. Notes previously shown only because they had a date will disappear from the planner; their files and properties are preserved. Existing-note picker and external drag and drop remain deferred.

The settings help, README and screenshots explain the marked-note model.

Validated with twenty-nine unit tests, official Obsidian lint, strict TypeScript, package checks and twenty-six native checks in the canonical development vault. The original demo notes and saved settings are preserved.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below. GitHub Actions builds, checks, attests and verifies all three files before publication.
